title: Combining Unsupervised Domain Adaptation and Semi-Supervised Learning for Power Line and Transmission Tower Segmentation
mechanism: UDA pretraining helps the network learn thin, low-feature power lines; SSL fine-tuning follows, with dynamic co-perturbation of image and features.
adaptation: Stage 1: UDA from UCF-EL (or the 478 labelled cells) to the pool. Stage 2: SSL on the pool with combined image and feature perturbation. Closest thin-structure SSL evidence found.
min_experiment: Only after reading the full text: a 2-stage arm vs house PF, 3 seeds. Metric: crack relF1@2 on clean-49 and E1. Kill if n.d.
evidence: R: self-built + public power-line sets; beats several SSL methods; no numbers in the abstract.
prior_overlap: UCF-EL encoder pretraining was erased by the house fine-tune. UDA-then-SSL was never run. Open.
